purpose.summary: This is the main patient registration program (P02) for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system used in Japanese medical clinics. It handles patient information entry, insurance combination management, hospitalization records, and claim processing. It coordinates multiple screens (P02, P02A, P02D-F, P014, P015, etc.) for patient registration workflows.

notable_features: Japanese medical association (JMA) ORCA open-source receipt software
Extensive use of COPY statements for modular copybook-based architecture (30+ COPY statements)
MCP (Message Control Program) event-driven screen handling pattern
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT for event dispatch
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern for screen state management
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS)
CLAIM processing via shell script invocation
111 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subroutines
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text comments encoded as latin-1 (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS misidentified). This is part of the well-known ORCA (Open Receipt Computer Advantage) system developed by JMA (Japan Medical Association), an open-source medical billing/receipt system for Japanese clinics. The program uses an event-driven MCP framework typical of the ORCA architecture rather than CICS, but the pattern is similar to online transaction processing. Version history in comments spans 2000-2004. The 'online-cics' program_type label is approximate; ORCA uses its own MCP framework, not CICS.
